title: Query complexity for bounded Fourier one-norm
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, let $s\in\mathbb R$ with $s\ge0$, and let $0<\varepsilon\le1/2$. Set $M=\max\{1,\lceil4s^2/\varepsilon\rceil\}$. Every output and cost pair in the support of the query-mode Kushilevitz–Mansour learning procedure with parameters $\varepsilon$ and $M$ has query cost at most $2^{64}(n+1)^2(s+1)^{16}/\varepsilon^{18}$.
